simple.meaning: to shut up; figuratively, to surrender
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to סָגַר (H5462) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 91 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: סָגַר (çâgar) means to shut up; figuratively, to surrender First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 6 20.

definitions.short: to shut up; figuratively, to surrender
definitions.usage: close up, deliver (up), give over (up), inclose, × pure, repair, shut (in, self, out, up, up together), stop, × straitly.
definitions.full: H5462. sagar I. סָגַר verb shut, close (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic סְגַר , id. ; Zinjirli מסגרת prison Lzb 328 ; Phoenician סגר Pi`el or Hiph`il deliver over ; possibly Ethiopic (prison) guard Prä BAS i. 371 ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ס Gen 19:6 +, 3 plural סָֽגְרוּ 2Chr 29:7 , סָֽגְר֑וּ Psa 17:10 (compare Baer's n., Ges § 29o Kö ii, 1, 535 Anm .), סָגָר֑וּ Gen 19:10 ; Josh 2:7 ; Imperfect יִסְגֹּר Job 12:14 ; Mal 1:10 , 1 plural cohortative נִסְגְּרָה Neh 6:10 , etc.; Imperative masculine singular סְגֹר Psa 35:3 ; Isa 26:20 ( וּסֲגֹר Baer Ginsb), masculine plural סִגְרוּ 2Kin 6:32 ; Infinitive construct לִסְגּוֺר Josh 2:5 ; Participle active סֹגֵר Isa 22:22 ; feminine סֹגֶּרֶת Josh 6:1 (but see below); passive סָגוּר 1Kin 6:20 12 t.; — 1 shut door ( דֶּלֶת ) Gen 19:10 (J) 2Kin 6:32 ; Mal 1:10 ; Neh 6:10 ; 2Chr 28:24 ; 29:7 ; gate ( שַׁעַר ) Josh 2:7 (JE) Ezek 46:12 , compare 44:1-2 ,(twice in verse); 46:1 , הַשּׁ ׳וַיְהִי לִסְגֹּר Josh 2:5 (JE), also ( שַׁעַר omitted) 6:1 (si vera 1.; סֹגֶרֶת dittograph according to Buhl Lex 13 ); door after one ( אַחֲרֵי ), on leaving room Gen 19:6 (J); upon, behind, oneself, from within ( בְּעַד q. v.) 2Kin 4:4-5 , 33 ; Isa 26:20 (figurative), also ( דֶּלֶת omitted) Judg 9:51 ; 2Kin 4:21 ; with דֶּלֶת + בְּעַד upon one left inside Judg 3:23 , and ( דֶּלֶת omitted) Gen 7:16 (J); figurative ׳ס בִטְנִי דַּלְתֵי Job 3:10 , compare ׳ס רַחְמָהּ 1Sam 1:5 , רַחְמָהּ ׳ס בְּעַד 1:6 ; absolute shut (opposed to מָּתַח ) Isa 22:22 (twice in verse); metaphor ס ׳חֶלְבָּמוֺ Psa 17:10 their fat (i.e. gross, unreceptive heart) they have closed . 2. a. close in upon ( בְּעַד ) Judg 3:22 (fat upon blade of sword), so possibly also תַּחְתֶּנָּה בָּשָׂר וַיִּסְגֹּר Gen 2:21 (J) and flesh closed in , in place of it (usually and he closed flesh, i.e. closed the gap with flesh); ׳ס הַמִּדְבָּר עֲלֵיהֶם Exod 14:3 the wilderness hath closed in upon them ; object omitted, עַלאִֿישׁ יִסְגֹּר Job 12:14 he closeth in upon a man , figurative of imprisonment. b. close up breach ( מֶּרֶץ ) [in wall] of city 1Kin 11:27 ; possibly close up [path] (si vera 1.) Psa 35:3 Vrss Ol De Bae; JDMich DeW Ew Hup-Now Che take סְגֹר here as weapon, usually battle-axe [Greek σάγαρις ] of Massagetae Herod i. 215 compare Lag Ges. Abh. 203 , also Egyptian sagart· (loan-word) Bondi 55 ; both improbable, text probably corrupt; Schw ZAW xi (1891), 258 reads חֲגֹר > Hal Rev. Sém. iii (1894), 47 עוּרָה (compare 59:5 ). 3 Passive participle, closed up = closely joined with tight seal, Job 41:7 (of scales of crocodile). 4 elsewhere only Passive participle in סָגוּר זָהָב (gold shut up , and so prized, rare, fine ?), only of temple adornment and utensils 1Kin 6:20-21 , 7:49-50 , 10:21 = 1Chr 9:20 ; 4:20 , 22 ; perhaps read סָגוּר (abbreviated for ׳ז ׳ס ) Job 28:15 (for סְגוֺר ᵑ0 , so Hoffm Bu Du): compare Assyrian —urâƒu sakru , Dl HWB 499 . Niph`al Perfect 3masculine singular נִסְגַּר 1Sam 23:7 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִסָּגֵר Ezek 46:2-3 ;feminine singular jussive תִּסָּגֵר Num 12:14 , וַתִּסָּגֵר 12:15 ; 3 masculine plural יִסָּנֵר֑וּ Isa 45:1 ; 60:11 , וַיִּסָּֽגְרוּ Neh 13:19 ; Imperative masculine singular הִסָּגֵר Ezek 3:24 ; — 1 subject person be shut up [in city] 1Sam 23:7 , לַמַּחֲנֶה מִחוּץ Num 12:14-15 , (E); בַּיִת בְּתוֺךְ Ezek 3:24 . 2 be shut, closed , of city gates Ezek 46:2 ; Isa 45:1 ; 60:11 and ( דלתות ) Neh 13:19 . Pi`el Perfect 3masculine singular סִגַּר 1Sam 26:8 ; 2Sam 18:28 ; suffix סִגְּרַנִי 1Sam 24:19 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix יְסַגֶּרְךָ 17:46 ; — deliver up to (leave no other opening for one, shut one up to), compare [ מָגַן ], מִגֵּן , p. 171 b above), only Samuel: with accusative of person + בְּיַד 17:46 ; 24:19 ; 26:8 ; בְּיַד omitted 2Sam 18:28 (see also Hiph`il ). p. 698 Pu`al Perfect 3masculine singular סֻגַּר Isa 24:10 ; 3 plural סֻגְּרוּ Jer 13:19 , וְסֻגְּרוּ consecutive Isa 24:22 ; Participle feminine מְסֻגֶּ֫רֶת Josh 6:1 ; — be shut up: 1 of cities Jer 13:19 (opposed to מָּתַח ), of beleaguered city Josh 6:1 (JE), of houses Isa 24:10 (+ מִבּוֺא ). 2 of prisoners עַלמַֿסְגֵּר Isa 24:22 = down into a dungeon. 3 of doors Eccl 12:14 . Hiph`il Perfect 3masculine singular הִסְגִּיר Lev 14:46 +; 2 masculine singular suffix הִסְגַּרְתַּ֫נִי Psa 31:9 ; 1 singular וְהִסְגַּרְתִּ֫י Amos 6:8 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יַסְגִּיר Job 11:10 , וַיַּסְגֵּר Psa 78:48 ; 78:62 ; 2 masculine singular תַּסְגִּר Deut 23:16 , jussive תַּסְגֵּר Obadiah 14, etc.; Infinitive construct הַסְגִּיר Amos 1:6 , suffix הַסְגִּירוֺ 1Sam 23:20 , הַסְגִּירָם Amos 1:9 ; — 1 deliver up to (compare Pi`el ), with accusative of person + בְּיַד 1Sam 23:11-12 , 20 ; 30:15 ; Josh 20:5 (D) Psa 31:9 ; + לְ Amos 1:9 ; Psa 78:50 ; 78:62 , and (accusative of person omitted) Amos 1:6 ; + אֶלֿ Deut 23:16 ; Job 16:11 ; with accusative of animal + לְ Psa 78:48 ; with accusative of person alone Deut 32:30 ; Obadiah 14, accusative omitted 1Sam 23:12 ; with accusative urb. alone Amos 6:8 . 2 shut up (late; chiefly Leviticus 13, 14, P): a. with accusative of person Lev 13:5 , 11 , 21 , 26 compare 13:4 ; 13:31 ; 13:33 , so (absolute) = imprison Job 11:10 ; with accusative of thing Lev 13:54 compare 13:50 . b. with accusative הַבַּיִת Lev 14:38 and (indefinite subject) 14:46 . סְגַר verb shut (see Biblical Hebrew) — Pe`al Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ס Dan 6:23 shut the lions' mouth (accusative).
